story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them. He is 3-3 with 743.58 points.

Week 6 was a 122.8 to 90.72 loss to Zygon, with Jonathan Taylor leading at 21.1, 43.4 left on the bench and a Sleeper report that put him at 68% of his perfect lineup. Week 5 was a 121.98 to 74.52 win over CMac91 with Bowers at 23.0. The losses have been close: 113.10 to 127.06 against YesChef23 in Week 1 and 127.74 to 139.80 against Hades9mm in Week 3.

He fell two spots to 7th. The quarterback room is still the open question, and Kyler Murray arrived free in Week 4. His 929.6 MAXPF gives him the 1.07, and the record says the roster is a better team than the lineup.
takes: The roster is fine. The bench is the problem.
The Issue 1 No. 1 label is a lot to carry, and so is a 43.4-point bench.
